CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   D. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
